description: This file defines the DelegateExecutor class interface and related functions for the native runtime executor in PyTorch, including processing, committing, and initializing weights, and running tensors.

classes.name: DelegateExecutor
classes.description: An abstract class serving as the extension point for delegation backends, managing weights processing, commitment, initialization, and execution of tensor inputs.

methods.name: processWeights
methods.description: Processes weights tensors, performing validation, leaf modifications, or constant folding before activation.

methods.name: commitWeights
methods.description: Activates previously processed weights for use in inference.

methods.name: initWeights
methods.description: Initializes weights tensors, possibly setting them up for subsequent processing.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes inference with input tensors and returns the output tensors.
